bullets: Camera: pan an' zoom anywhere on da table.
Units: pick 'em from da list or da board, datasheet for da full stats.
Da left panel logs everyfing — Game Log an' Dice Log tabs.
Da big red button ends da phase. Da small one ends a unit's move.
Forgot a control? Da pause menu (Escape, or View on a pad) lists every key under Controls an' every button under Controller.
Next lesson: Musterin' da Boyz — deployment, transports an' leaders.

prompt.kbm: Welcome to Basic Trainin'. You know da rules of da tabletop — dis teaches how [b]da app[/b] works. Use [i]Skip Step[/i] or [i]Exit Tutorial[/i] up 'ere any time.
prompt.pad: Welcome to Basic Trainin'. You know da rules — dis teaches how [b]da app[/b] works. Whenever dis card shows [b]Continue[/b], press {a}. [i]Skip Step[/i] an' [i]Exit Tutorial[/i] are up 'ere too.

prompt.kbm: Look over da whole table: pan wiv da arrow keys (or {key:camera_pan_up} {key:camera_pan_left} {key:camera_pan_down} {key:camera_pan_right}), an' zoom in an' out wiv da mouse wheel. Try 'em all.
prompt.pad: Look over da whole table: shove {rs} every way to pan, den zoom in wiv {rt} an' out wiv {lt}. Try 'em all.

on_enter.script:
if main != null and main.has_method("reset_camera_gestures"):
	main.reset_camera_gestures()

items.label: Up
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("pan_up")

items.label: Down
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("pan_down")

items.label: Left
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("pan_left")

items.label: Right
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("pan_right")

items.label: Zoom in
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("zoom_in")

items.label: Zoom out
items.script: return main != null and main.has_method("camera_gesture_used") and main.camera_gesture_used("zoom_out")

hint.kbm: Tick every box: pan all four ways wiv da arrow keys, den roll da wheel forward an' back. Stuck on one? [i]Skip Step[/i] up 'ere moves on.
hint.pad: Tick every box: push {rs} all four ways, den squeeze {rt} an' {lt}. Stuck on one? [i]Skip Step[/i] up 'ere moves on.

prompt.kbm: Click [b]Battlewagon[/b] in da unit list on da right — or click its token up in your deployment zone.
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} to cycle units until da [b]Battlewagon[/b] is picked — or point {ls} at its token on da board an' press {a}.

done.script:
var mc = main.get("movement_controller")
return mc != null and str(mc.active_unit_id) == "U_BATTLEWAGON_T"

hint.text: Da unit list is top-right — da Battlewagon row. If dat list looks empty, point at da wagon on da board an' pick it dere instead.

prompt.kbm: Press {key:datasheet_modal} to open da unit's full datasheet.
prompt.pad: Press {y} to open da unit's full datasheet.

prompt.kbm: Da left panel logs everyfing wot 'appens. Click da [b]Dice Log[/b] tab — every roll ends up dere.
prompt.pad: Da left panel logs everyfing. Glide {ls} onto da [b]Dice Log[/b] tab an' press {a}.

done.script:
var glp = tree.root.get_node_or_null("/root/Main/GameLogPanel")
return glp != null and str(glp._active_tab) == "dice"

prompt.pad: Dat strip at da bottom always shows wot each button does [i]right now[/i]. It changes wiv da situation — when in doubt, read da bar. Right now it says {a} Continue, so squeeze {a} to carry on.

hint.pad: Da bar 'as da answer: press {a} to hit [b]Continue[/b]. Or point {ls} at da button an' press {a} — bofe work.

prompt.kbm: Press {key:hotkey_help} to see every keyboard shortcut in da game.
prompt.pad: Press {view} for da pause menu. Da [b]Controller[/b] tab lists every button ya got — an' lets ya swap 'em about.

hint.kbm: No keyboard handy (Steam Deck an' such)? Grab da pad: {view} opens da pause menu, an' da [b]Controller[/b] tab lists every button.
hint.pad: {view} is da ⧉ View/Select button — dat opens da pause menu. Da tab row is along da top: land on [b]Controller[/b] an' press {a}.

prompt.kbm: Press {key:hotkey_help} again to put da cheat sheet away.
prompt.pad: Give da [b]Controller[/b] tab a butcher's, den press {b} (or {view}) to shut da menu.

prompt.text: Dat big red button ends da current phase for good. [b]Don't[/b] press it yet — first, a bit of movin'.

prompt.kbm: Click [b]Gretchin[/b] in da unit list, den [b]drag[/b] one grot a short way forward an' drop it.
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} until da [b]Gretchin[/b] are picked, glide {ls} onto a grot, press {a} to grab it, walk it forward an' press {a} to drop it.

hint.text: Pick da Gretchin row first — den drag any single grot base. Keep 'im near his mates (wivin 2") an' don't drop him on top of anyone.

prompt.kbm: Press [b]End This Unit's Move[/b] on da right to lock da move in.
prompt.pad: Check da hint bar — confirm da move to lock it in.

prompt.text: Camera, pickin' units, datasheets, logs, an' yer first move order. Da next lesson covers [b]deployment, transports an' leaders[/b]. WAAAGH!
